description: The resource budget gate e2e-6 holds a release candidate to (journey e2e6.budget, and e2e6.pressure's body check). Growth is measured after a two-minute warm-up, between the first and last sample of fifteen minutes of mixed calls on one transient agent. Set from the m12b soak's Rust figures (evidence/m12b/README.md: RSS peak 86 MiB, epoch-end slope 129 MiB/h, about 32 MiB over 15 min; FDs peak 17, slope 7/h) with 1.5x headroom on growth and 3x on the peak. A change needs a commit that says why.
